purpose: Track claims, limits, and unresolved truth boundaries so runtime language does not outrun evidence.
principle: Truth includes uncertainty; uncertainty named early does not become drift later.

uncertainties.statement: Runtime truth refresh automation exists, but scheduled and push-trigger behavior must be observed over real runs before claiming lifecycle-wide automation.
uncertainties.needed_evidence: Successful GitHub Action run that refreshes artifacts only when contents change.

uncertainties.statement: Public runtime truth artifacts summarize observable receipts; they do not prove hidden local runtime state unless receipts are emitted and surfaced.
uncertainties.needed_evidence: Linked receipt bundle with governance, canon, protocol, capability, and symbolic boundary outputs.

uncertainties.statement: Symbolic context may be present, but symbolic dependency must remain forbidden and tested.
uncertainties.needed_evidence: Boundary tests confirming symbolic material stays in supplemental context and cannot authorize governance, canon, capability exposure, or checkpoint legality.

uncertainties.statement: Lumina currently functions as a governed continuity/runtime substrate, not a full desktop operating system with driver, package, kernel, and application-launch parity.
uncertainties.needed_evidence: Installable image or desktop substrate milestone with documented OS-level capabilities.

uncertainties.statement: Meta-pulse findings are heuristic drift indicators, not governance law or proof of failure.
uncertainties.needed_evidence: Repeated reports showing stable categories, low false positives, and useful corrective actions.
